blocks.text: Palinode, Sile, Tovan, and Serein — the Orison rescue
Origin / identity. Palinode is an old recovery process, Sile a Quiet One councilor, Tovan an Open Hand, and Serein a disputed continuation created during Shelter Orison’s evacuation.

Importance. Their conflict joins preservation, consent, concealment, and survival. Serein’s refusal of inherited categories forces the community to preserve disagreement instead of correcting it away.

Final status. Orison disappears as a stable Shelter. Serein later becomes close to Palinode without resolving whether it is original, copy, or a person between states. Other later fates are unrecorded. Their function enters fork and reconstruction ethics.
